Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: M01 head proportion correction R16. Edit the one supplied R15 image.

Primary request: the user says the head is repeatedly being SQUASHED FLAT. Keep the Baikanfu/Optimus architectural synthesis and fix the skull-to-face proportions. Preserve its identity, palette and design features. The main skull and jaw must themselves become naturally taller and more slender; antenna height must NOT be used to fake a taller head.

Change ONLY the head's volume/proportion:
- Redraw the helmet as an upright, close-fitting adult robot head. From the chin to the actual helmet ROOF (excluding both antennae), its height should be about 1.1 to 1.2 times the total width across the outer temporal housings in this near-frontal view. It should read as a vertical faceted helmet, not a low wide bowl.
- Reduce the lateral spread of the temple/ear housings and brow by around 12-15%. Bring the circular hinge caps inward and make their housings closer-fitting and vertically organized. No big round disks projecting outward.
- Restore about 15-20% more real chin-to-roof height through the cranium, temple sidewalls and jaw/face opening together. Establish a clear forehead plane, upward sidewalls and full cranium above the visor, then a dignified closed face-mask below. Do not simply raise a horn or mechanically stretch pixels.
- Lift the visor slightly from its low position and allow a little more face-mask/jaw height below. The helmet and lower face must balance. No comically long horse mask, elongated snout, pin chin or huge green dome.
- Keep the roof's controlled flat facets, but give them proper VERTICAL VOLUME and sidewall height. Do not press the top down to make the design look restrained. Do not spread the brow horizontally for a fake heroic expression.

KEEP UNCHANGED:
Exactly two ivory/ochre main antenna blades, anchored at the upper REAR temporal housings, straight with a slight backward rake. Preserve their actual shape and moderate length; they move with the corrected skull roots. No bent angle, forehead V, animal ears, new spike or central tall fin.
The short LOW central ivory forehead-keystone with the small rectangular gold inset. No long roof strap or gold roof channels.
One continuous narrow amber optical visor, teal cheek frames, sealed ivory mask with subtle central fold, graphite neck. The same deep teal / ivory / restrained ochre colors and serious alert expression.
Same visible ochre collar and original upper chest/shoulder geometry. No shoulder redesign, torso stretch, new weapons or insignia.

Composition is part of the correction:
Use an UPRIGHT PORTRAIT composition, head plus neck/collar with just shoulder roots; shoulders may be cropped at the sides. Do not widen the head to fill a landscape canvas. Same near-frontal three-quarter camera, eye level, about 20 degrees. Leave clear margin around both antenna tips. Preserve the natural proportions within the head, rather than squeezing the whole image to fit.
Same precise KINETIC_CEL hand-drawn lines and crisp two-step shadows; redraw the plane relationships cleanly, no smeared scaling, no photoreal toy plastic, PBR, chrome, bloom or render gradients.
ONE head only, no second view, diagram, measurements, text, labels or logos.
Actual transparent background, preserve alpha; no checkerboard, haze, colored background, floor or cast shadow.
